title: Canonical continuous-ring realization in the scheme universe
statement: Let T be a totally disconnected topological ring in universe u and X a scheme in universe u. The canonical comparison p_X^* C(-,T) to the abelian sheaf U ↦ ULift C(|U|,T), defined by the inverse-image adjunction and the profinite test projection, is an isomorphism and preserves multiplication and unit. No field structure or Type 0 restriction is assumed.

source.place: Example 3.1; parent comparison proof steps 2--5; for local Smith, Theorem 6.12(2) pivot/division argument.

proof.text: Define the adjoint by precomposition with the profinite test projection; naturality is the projection naturality equation. Construct the ring-valued adjoint and use the sheaf-compose monoid comparison to prove preservation of ring operations.

On an affine weakly contractible test object, use the terminal point-component arrow in the point-Lan diagram. Total disconnectedness factors every continuous coefficient through connected components, giving a bijection on sections. The sheafification unit is invertible on this basis. The affine weakly contractible basis criterion makes the comparison an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Detailed proof of the corresponding part of lem-sfb-integral-lfp-constant-model-comparison; explicit universe-polymorphic coefficient construction.
